requirement:
HC's issue-content implementation can cache a fetched issue snapshot with a
fetch time and an application-selected TTL. When caching is enabled, reads
within the TTL reuse that snapshot. After expiry, a network-enabled read obtains
a refreshed snapshot before returning contents, or reports a refresh failure.
The returned contents, formatter, and fingerprint remain based on the same
snapshot.
rationale: Add tests marked {test}`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.cache` for the HC issue-content cache. Cover: (1) with caching enabled, a read within the TTL reuses the stored snapshot with no new fetch; (2) after expiry, a network-enabled read fetches a refreshed snapshot and returns its contents; (3) after expiry, a failed refresh is reported as a refresh failure and does not return stale contents; (4) the returned contents, formatter output and fingerprint all come from the same snapshot, for example when the issue changes between fetches. Then remove or update the stale {fixme} in `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`. — I found no {test} reference or :test: anchor for this requirement, and no test of TTL reuse, expiry refresh, refresh failure or snapshot consistency. Searches of `src` and `tests` for TTL, snapshot and cache found only the CLI issue-state cache test `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[closing_an_acknowledged_issue_makes_the_fixme_record_stale_and_reassessed]`. That is a separate interface and does not cover graph issue contents. The only acknowledgment is the {fixme} in `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`. It names nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26, which is closed, so it no longer acknowledges the gap.
